WPSS No. 177 of 2018 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Dushyant Mainali, Advocate 
for the petitioner. 
Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Standing 
Counsel for the State. 
Heard on urgency application. 
Urgency application (IA No. 469 of 
2018) is allowed. 
Issue notice to the respondent 
Nos. 5, 6, 7 and 8, by registered post, 
acknowledgment due, returnable at an 
early date. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
List this matter on 28.02.2018. 
In the meantime, it is provided 
that promotion, if any, to the post of 
Treasury Officer, shall be subject to 
final outcome of the writ petition. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
 Vacation Judge
